title: Audience-first GTM: how Adam Robinson built RB2B demand through LinkedIn founder content
summary: Adam Robinson explains how he built an audience on LinkedIn first and then built RB2B for it, using organic founder content, radical transparency and podcast cross-pollination as a low-cost, bootstrapped demand engine. He also shares stories of starting from zero three times, why VC doesn't accelerate sub-$10M ARR companies, and why a clear one-liner can launch a product.

principles.text: Build the audience first, then build the product they already want to buy.
principles.quote: we hadn't even really decided to make the B2B product until we saw how effective this content vehicle was
